answer: It fails closed: a failed invariant aborts the run instead of writing a run record, so no plausible but invalid partial record is produced. The reference engine writes a run record only after the model, scenario and result hashes are known; in the documented run life cycle, invariants are checked after the replications and before metric aggregation, convergence/sensitivity and hashing, with the record write last. An invariant failure therefore stops the run before the record is created, mirroring the stated intent to prevent partial writes.
